description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care quality and operational excellence, ensuring the highest standards of service delivery. The facility is committed to fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background and a passion for geriatric care. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this role quickly. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience. If you are a visionary nursing leader ready to make a difference, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 3-5 years of progressive nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
Proven ability to manage and mentor a diverse nursing team.
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
